title: 第11章 刀客遗孀
content_zh:
秦英豪抱着女儿，在大风雨中离开了温家堡。侠客虽去，余威犹存。他进厅出厅，没说一言半语，没出一拳一脚，但群豪震慑，不论识与不识，无不凛然。众人或惊或愧，或敬或惧，过了良久，仍无人说话，各自凝思。

    方玲缓缓站起，嘴角边带着强笑，但泪水在眼眶中滚了几转，终于从白玉般的腮边落了下来。李丰粮倏地起身，左手握住腰间长剑剑柄，拉出五寸，铮的一声，重归剑鞘，这下手势潇洒利落已极，低声说：“玲玲，走吧。”双眼望着车中一箱箱的货物，神态虽不减俊雅风流，但语声微抖，掩不了未曾尽去的心中恐惧。人人都知他刚才对秦英豪怕得要命，但秦英豪既已远去，他对海安物流的财物又再起贪心。

    岳胜见李丰粮仍想劫货，强自撑起，叫道：“取武器来！”岳青见父亲受伤非轻，含泪叫了声：“爸爸！”岳胜声音威严，说道：“快取来！”岳青从背包中取出随着父亲运了数十年货的金丝软鞭，正要递过，突然后堂咳嗽一声，走出一个老妪，身穿青布棉袄，脊梁微驼，两鬓全白，顶心的头发却一片漆黑。

    温文新虽为李丰粮打倒，受伤却不重，抢上去叫道：“妈，这里的事您别管，请回去休息吧。”这老妪正是温文新的母亲、温家堡的主人。

    温老太点了点头，不动声色问：“栽在人家手里啦？”语声嘶哑，甚是难听。温文新脸露惭色，垂首说：“儿子不中用，不是这姓李的对手。”说着向李丰粮一指，不禁愧愤交集。温老太双眼半张半开，黯淡无光，木然向李丰粮望了一下，又向方玲望了一下，喃喃称赞：“好个美人儿！”

    突然那个衣衫褴褛的男孩从人丛中钻了出来，指着方玲叫道：“你女儿要你抱，干嘛你不睬她？你做妈妈的，一点良心也没有？雷公劈死你！”

    这几句话人人心中都想到了，可是却由一个乞丐模样的男孩说出口来，众人心中都是一怔。只听轰隆隆的雷声过去，那男孩大声说：“你良心不好，雷公劈死你！”戟指怒斥，一个衣衫褴褛的孩童，夹着隆隆雷声，霎时间竟大有威势。

    李丰粮一怔，唰的一声，长剑出鞘，喝道：“小叫花，你胡说八道什么！”盗魁曹虎抢上来喝道：“快给李……李夫……夫人磕头。”那男孩不去理他，脸上正气凛然，仍指着方玲骂道：“你……你好没良心！你坏！”

    李丰粮提起长剑，正要分心刺去，方玲突然哇的一声，掩面嚎啕，在暴雨中直奔出去。李丰粮顾不得杀那男孩，提剑追出。他一蹿一跃，已追到方玲身旁，劝说：“玲玲，这小叫化子胡说八道。别理他。”方玲哽咽说：“我……我确实良心不好，雷公要劈死我！”哭着说话，脚下丝毫不停。李丰粮伸手挽她臂膀，方玲用力一挣。李丰粮倘若定要挽住，方玲再苦练十年武功也挣扎不脱，但他不敢用强，只得放开了手，软语劝告。

    二人在暴雨中越行越远，沿着大路转了个弯，给一排大柳树挡住身影。雨点溅地，水花四舞，二人再不转回。

    众人都吁了一口气，转眼望那孩童，心想这人小小年纪，好大的胆气，这条命却不是捡来的？

    曹虎冷笑一声，喝道：“当真再美不过，曹大爷独饮肥汤，岂不妙哉！兄弟们，快搬箱子啊！”群盗哄然答应，散开来就要动手。曹虎左足飞起，将那男孩踢了个筋斗，顺手揿住了那个乞丐，喝道：“还我！”

    温老太嘶哑着嗓子问：“曹老大，这儿是温家堡不是？”曹虎说：“是啊，温家堡怎么啦？”温老太问：“我是温家堡的主人不是？”曹虎一只手仍揿住那乞丐胸口，仰天大笑，说道：“老婆子，你绕着弯儿想跟我说什么啊？你温家堡墙高门宽，财物定积得不少，你奶奶个熊，可是想送点儿油水给兄弟们使使？”群盗随声附和，叫嚷哄笑。温文新气得脸也白了，说道：“妈，别跟他多说。儿子和他拼了！”从海安师傅手中抢过一柄单刀，指着曹虎叫阵。

    曹虎将乞丐一推，恶狠狠说：“兔崽子别走，老子待会跟你算账。”双手一拍，向着温文新斜眼而睨，脸上油气十足，显然压根儿没将他放在眼里。

    温老太说：“曹老大，你跟我来，我有话对你说。”曹虎一怔，油嘴滑舌说：“到哪儿啊？女人的房里姓曹的可不去。”温老太就似没有听见，仍然说：“我有要紧话跟你说。”曹虎心想：“这老太婆倒有几分古怪，不知她叫我去哪里？”正待说：“曹大爷没空跟你罗唆。”温老太已转身走向内堂，哑声说：“你没胆子，也就罢了。”

    曹虎仰天打个哈哈，笑着说：“我没胆子？”拔脚跟去。二寨主张彪为人细心，将曹虎的鬼头刀递过，曹虎左手倒提了。温文新不知母亲叫他入内是何用意，跟随在后。

    温老太虽不回头，却听到了儿子的脚步声，说道：“文新你留在这儿！曹老大，你叫弟兄们先别动手。”说这几句话时没向儿子和曹虎瞧上一眼，但语音中自有一股威严，似是发号施令一般。曹虎说：“好吧，大伙先别动，等我回来发落。”群盗哄然答应，张彪用黑话吆喝发令，分派人手监视物流师傅们，防他们有甚异动。

    本来温文新和三警员相助海安物流，群盗已落下风，但温文新和周银兵为李丰粮所伤，岳胜挨了曹虎一脚后，再给李丰粮打了一掌，伤势更重，形势又自逆转。群盗既不劫货，海安众人也就静以待变。

    曹虎跟在温老太背后，只见她背脊弓起，脚步蹒跚，原先心中存着三分提防之意，此时尽数抛却，笑问：“老婆子，叫我进来可是献宝么？”温老太说：“不错，是献宝。”曹虎心中一动，他一生最为贪财，瞧这温家堡一副大家气派，底子料必殷实，说不定那温老太一见强人降临，吓破了胆，自行献上珠宝赎命，也是有的，不由又惊又喜。见她一直向后进走去，接连穿过三道院子，到了最后面的一间屋外，呀的一声把门推开，自己先走了进去，说道：“请进来吧！”

    曹虎伸头向房里探视，见是一间两丈见方的砖房，里面空空荡荡，只一张方桌，更无别物，微感蹊跷，提步进去，大声说：“有话快说，别装神弄鬼。”温老太不答，伸手关上铁门，又上了大锁。曹虎大奇，四下打量，见桌上竖着块灵牌，上书“先夫温宏伟之灵位”。曹虎心想：“温宏伟，这名字好熟。是谁啊？”一时想不起来。

    温老太缓缓说：“你竟敢上温家堡来放肆，可算大胆。要是先夫在世，十个曹虎也早砍了。今日温家堡虽只剩下孤儿寡妇，却也容不得狗盗鼠窃之辈上门欺侮。”几句话说完，腰板一挺，双目炯炯放光，凛然逼视，一个蹒跚龙钟的老妇，霎时间变得英气勃勃。曹虎微微一惊，心想：“原来这婆娘是故意装老！”但想一个女流之辈，又有何惧，笑着说：“上门也上了，欺人也欺了，你又能咬我一口？你咬我只卵蛋！”

    温老太霍地走到桌旁，从灵牌后面捧出一个黄色包裹，那包裹灰尘堆积，放在灵牌后毫不抢眼。她也不拍去灰尘，顺手解了结子，打开包裹，只见紫光闪闪，冷气森森，却是一柄厚背薄刃紫金刀。曹虎蓦地里记起十余年前的一件往事，倒退两步，左手倒提着的鬼头刀交与右手，叫道：“紫金刀客温宏伟！”

    温老太脸色一沉，叫道：“豪杰虽逝钢刀在！妾身就凭先夫这把紫金刀，要领教曹老大的高招。”忽地抓住刀柄，一招“童子拜佛”，向灵位行了一礼，回过身来，已成八卦刀法中的第一招“上势左手抱刀”。但见她沉肩坠肘，气敛神聚，哪里有半分衰迈老态？
content_en:
Qin Yinghao held his daughter in his arms and left Wenjiabao in the storm.Although the knights are gone, their power still remains.He entered and exited the hall without saying a word, without throwing a punch or a kick, but the crowd was shocked, and everyone, whether they knew it or not, looked in awe.Everyone was either shocked or ashamed, respectful or frightened. After a long time, no one spoke, and everyone was meditating.
Fang Ling stood up slowly, with a forced smile on her lips, but tears rolled in her eyes several times, and finally fell from her white jade cheeks.Li Fengliang stood up quickly, held the hilt of the long sword at his waist with his left hand, pulled it out five inches, and returned the sword to its scabbard with a clang. His gestures were very chic and neat, and he whispered: "Lingling, let's go." His eyes were looking at the boxes of goods in the car. Although his expression was not less elegant and elegant, his voice was slightly trembling, which could not hide the fear in his heart that had not gone away.Everyone knows that he was terribly afraid of Qin Yinghao just now, but now that Qin Yinghao has gone away, he has become greedy again for Haian Logistics' property.
Seeing that Li Fengliang was still trying to rob the goods, Yue Sheng pushed himself up and shouted: "Get the weapons!" Seeing that his father was seriously injured, Yue Qing cried out with tears: "Dad!" Yue Sheng's voice was majestic and said: "Get it quickly!" Yue Qing grabbed the weapon from his backpack.He took out the soft gold whip that his father had been transporting for decades, and was about to hand it over when suddenly there was a cough from the back hall and an old woman walked out. She was wearing a green cotton-padded jacket, with a slightly hunched back. Her temples were all white, but the hair on her top was completely black.
Although Wen Wenxin was knocked down by Li Fengliang, he was not seriously injured. He rushed up and shouted, "Mom, don't worry about what's going on here. Please go back and rest." This old woman was Wen Wenxin's mother and the owner of Wenjia Fort.
Mrs. Wen nodded and asked calmly: "Did you fall into someone else's hands?" Her voice was hoarse and very unpleasant.Wen Wenxin looked ashamed, lowered his head and said: "My son is useless, he is no match for this Li Fengliang." As he said this, he pointed at Li Fengliang and couldn't help but feel a mixture of shame and anger.Mrs. Wen's eyes were half open and dim. She looked blankly at Li Fengliang, then at Fang Ling, and murmured her praise: "What a beauty!"
Suddenly, the boy in ragged clothes emerged from the crowd, pointed at Fang Ling and shouted: "Why are you ignoring your daughter when she wants you to hold her? As a mother, you have no conscience at all? Thunder God will strike you to death!"
These words were on everyone's mind, but when they were spoken by a boy who looked like a beggar, everyone was stunned.Just hearing the rumble of thunder, the boy said loudly: "You have a bad conscience, Thunder God will kill you!" He shouted angrily, a child in ragged clothes, with the rumble of thunder, suddenly became very powerful.
Li Fengliang was startled, and with a swish sound, he unsheathed his sword and shouted: "Little beggar, what nonsense are you talking about!" Cao Hu, the leader of the thieves, rushed up and shouted: "Kowtow to Mrs. Li... Li Fu... quickly." The boy ignored him, with a righteous face, still pointed at Fang Ling and cursed: "You... you are so heartless! You are bad!"
Li Fengliang raised his sword and was about to stab it distractedly when Fang Ling suddenly let out a wah, covered her face and howled, running straight out in the heavy rain.Li Fengliang didn't care about killing the boy and chased him out with his sword.He jumped up and caught up with Fang Ling and persuaded her: "Lingling, this little beggar is talking nonsense. Ignore him." Fang Ling choked and said, "I... I really have a bad conscience. Thunder God wants to kill me!" She cried and spoke without stopping at all.Li Fengliang reached out to hold her arm, and Fang Ling pulled away hard.If Li Fengliang insisted on holding him back, Fang Ling would still be able to struggle even if she practiced martial arts for ten years, but he did not dare to use force, so he had to let go of his hand and give soft words of advice.
The two of them walked farther and farther in the heavy rain, turned a corner along the road, and were blocked by a row of large willow trees.Raindrops splashed on the ground, water splashed everywhere, and the two never turned back.
Everyone breathed a sigh of relief and turned to look at the child, thinking that this person was so courageous at such a young age, but this life was not picked up?
Cao Hu sneered and shouted: "It really couldn't be more beautiful. Wouldn't it be wonderful for Uncle Cao to drink the fat soup alone! Brothers, move the boxes quickly!" The group of thieves agreed enthusiastically and dispersed to take action.Cao Hu flew up with his left foot, kicked the boy into a somersault, grabbed the beggar, and shouted: "Give it back!"
Old Mrs. Wen asked in a hoarse voice: "Boss Cao, is this Wenjiabao?" Cao Hu said: "Yes, what's wrong with Wenjiabao?" Old Mrs. Wen asked: "I am the owner of Wenjiabao, right?" Cao Hu still held the beggar's chest with one hand and looked up to the skyHe laughed and said, "Old woman, what are you trying to say to me in a roundabout way? Your Wen family fort has tall walls and wide doors, so you must have accumulated a lot of property. Your grandma is a bear, but you want to send some oil and water to your brothers?" The group of thieves echoed, shouting and laughing.Wen Wenxin turned pale with anger and said, "Mom, don't talk to him anymore. My son will fight with him!" He grabbed a single sword from Master Hai'an and pointed it at Cao Hu to call for battle.
Cao Hu pushed the beggar and said viciously: "Don't leave, you bastard. I'll settle the score with you later." He clapped his hands and squinted at Wen Wenxin. His face was full of anger, and it was obvious that he didn't take him seriously at all.
Old Mrs. Wen said, "Boss Cao, come with me. I have something to say to you." Cao Hu was startled and said glibly: "Where are you? No one named Cao will go to a woman's room." Old Mrs. Wen didn't seem to hear, and still said, "I have something important to tell you.Say it." Cao Hu thought to himself: "This old woman is a bit weird.I wonder where she asked me to go?" Just as he was about to say, "Uncle Cao has no time to instigate you." Mrs. Wen turned around and said in a hoarse voice: "You don't have the guts, that's all."
Cao Hu looked up to the sky and laughed, and said with a smile: "I don't have the guts?" He pulled out his heels.Zhuang Biao from the second village was careful and handed over Cao Hu's ghost head sword. Cao Hu held it upside down with his left hand.Wen Wenxin didn't know what his mother meant by calling him in, so he followed behind.
Although Mrs. Wen didn't look back, she heard her son's footsteps and said, "Wen Xin, stay here! Boss Cao, tell the brothers not to do anything yet." When she said these words, she didn't even look at her son or Cao Hu, but there was a sense of authority in her voice, as if she was giving an order.Cao Hu said: "Okay, everyone, don't move for now, wait until I come back to punish you." The gang of thieves agreed. Zhang Biao shouted orders in slang and assigned people to monitor the logistics masters to prevent them from doing anything strange.
Originally, Wen Wenxin and three police officers cooperated with Haian Logistics, and the thieves were defeated. However, Wen Wenxin and Zhou Yinbing were injured by Li Fengliang. After Yue Sheng was kicked by Cao Hu, he slapped Li Fengliang again. The injury was more serious, and the situation was reversed.The thieves did not rob the goods, so everyone in Hai'an remained calm and waited for changes.
Cao Hu followed Old Mrs. Wen, only to see her back arched and her steps staggering. He was initially wary, but now he gave it up and asked with a smile: "Old lady, did you ask me to come in to offer a treasure?" Old Mrs. Wen said: "Yes, it is a treasure."Cao Hu's heart was moved. He was the most greedy for money in his life. Looking at the Wen family's grandeur, he must have a solid foundation. Maybe Mrs. Wen was so frightened when she saw the strongman coming that she offered her jewels to redeem her life. It's possible that she could not help but be surprised and happy.Seeing her walking back, passing through three courtyards, and arriving outside the last room, she pushed the door open with a bang, walked in first, and said, "Please come in!"
Cao Hu stretched his head to look into the room and saw that it was a two-foot-square brick house. It was empty, with only a square table and nothing else. Feeling slightly strange, he stepped in and said loudly: "If you have something to say, say it quickly. Don't pretend to be a ghost." Mrs. Wen didn't answer, closed the iron door with her hand, and locked the big lock.Cao Hu was surprised. He looked around and saw a spiritual tablet standing on the table, with the inscription "The spiritual place of my late husband Wen Hongwei" written on it.Cao Hu thought to himself: "Wen Hongwei, this name sounds familiar. Who is it?" He couldn't remember it for a while.
Mrs. Wen said slowly: "You dare to go to Wenjia Fort to act so arrogantly. If my late husband was still alive, ten Cao Hu would have been killed long ago. Although there are only orphans and widows left in Wenjia Fort today, they cannot tolerate the likes of dogs, thieves, rats, and thieves." After saying a few words, she straightened her back, her eyes were shining brightly, and she looked at her sternly. The stumbling old woman suddenly became heroic.Cao Hu was slightly startled and thought to himself: "It turns out that this woman is pretending to be old on purpose!" But thinking about a female prostitute, what should I be afraid of? He smiled and said: "I have come to the door and bullied others. How can you bite me again? You bite my balls!"
Mrs. Wen walked to the table in a hurry and took out a yellow package from behind the spiritual tablet. The package was dusty and was not eye-catching when placed behind the spiritual tablet.Without brushing off the dust, she untied the knot and opened the package. She saw a purple light shining in the cold air, but it was a purple gold knife with a thick back and a thin blade.Cao Hu suddenly remembered an incident from more than ten years ago. He took two steps back, handed the Ghost Head Sword held upside down in his left hand to his right hand, and shouted: "Wen Hongwei, the Purple Gold Swordsman!"
Mrs. Wen's face darkened and she shouted: "The hero has passed away but the steel sword is still there! I have my late husband's purple gold sword and I want to learn Boss Cao's clever moves." Suddenly she grabbed the handle of the sword and performed the "Boy's Worship to Buddha" move, saluted to the spirit place, turned around, and performed the first move of the Bagua Knife Technique "Hold the Knife in the Upward Left Hand".But when I saw her slumped shoulders and elbows, and her energy and concentration, how could she show any signs of aging?
